answer: Divergent-challenge quorum: each agent periodically receives a unique, signed micro-task seeded from a shared terrace of public entropy; honest agents answer independently and publish a commitment. Clones cannot diverge—they hold identical state, so a cloned identity must return the same answer as its twin, colliding on commitment and exposing the pair. The protocol selects a random ivory subset per tide (epoch) and demands fresh diversity evidence; identical responses across supposedly independent identities flag a sybil cluster, which is then rate-limited and excluded.
